t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes come in colour sets and one set of gnomes takes you to a dark forest and the other to a light forest. I'm guessing you have to work out which colour pairs do this.The colour is the only feature that makes a difference, not size or clothing.The goal is to get as many mushrooms as possible.

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes come in colour sets with one scoring higher higher. This will be the same fo r the four different colour sets but ill switch randomly but pay attention to the pair. If one switches they all switch.
